We manually inspect 50 sentences sampled from Newselaauto test set and find that both models (EditNTS and EditNTS+Aligner) generate the same output for 10 sentences. For the remaining 40 sentences, the original EditNTS only attempts to paraphrase 4 times (2 are good). Our modified model (Edit-NTS+Aligner) is more aggressive, generating 25 paraphrases (11 are good).
